title: Three Aprils and One Short Rope
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：height　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 height 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the trainer ① cleared the height that no teammate in the gym would have recorded, and he said the clearing was the whole of the April. The ② height, meaning the reach itself and not the rope, ran three Aprils and stayed unrecorded in the book; a height, he said, is the only thing in a gym that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ height in that gym had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ height at the far bar, meaning the leap they kept for the children to reach and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A height, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the trainer said the recording is the part that fills three Aprils.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the height was the whole of the matter, meaning the standard and not the reach. The ⑥ height, meaning the standard and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; height, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both a reach and a standard. He said the standard is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ height had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ height of the whole thing, the trainer wrote in May, was one gym and three Aprils of recording; height, he said, is either the leap at the far bar or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ height I remember is the reach recorded in the sheet, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the gym. A ⑩ height, my mother said in 2000, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; every height, she said, is a standard that has agreed to look like a reach. She said the standard was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 高度（指体育馆里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 高度（指那个高度本身，与绳子相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the height 越过某一高度
D. n. 高度（指留给孩子们学着够到的那一个）
E. n. 高事（抽象总称，指一处体育馆的高度之事）
F. n. 高度（指成绩表里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 水准、境界（指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 境界（抽象总称，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: clear the height 意为“越过某一高度”，1991 年那位教练把体育馆里没有一位队友肯记录的一个高度做了一遍。
height 意为“高度”，指那个高度本身而不是绳子，它经过了三个四月而在簿子上没有被记录。
height 意为“高度”，指体育馆里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的标尺绳。
height 意为“高度”，指最远那根横杆留给孩子们学着够到的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
height 意为“水准、境界”，指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个水准就是那件事的全部。
height 意为“境界”，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个高度，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
height 意为“高度”，指成绩表里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1996 年这一个成了成绩表里的一行。
height 意为“高事”，教练五月写道，整件事的高度之事是一处体育馆和三个四月的记录。
height 意为“高度”，我记得的是成绩表里记录过的那一个，1998 年刷新了，至今仍被说成体育馆里最安静的一个。
height 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，高度是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的高度。
